newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan's air cargo traffic down 15.7 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Milan's air cargo traffic down 15.7 pct in 1996.

text.p: Cargo traffic handled by Milan's airport system totalled 164 million kg in 1996, down 15.7 percent on the previous year, said its operating company SEA.

At the city's Malpensa airport, used for long-haul, primarily inter-continental flights, SEA reported that 1996 cargo volume dropped 22.4 percent from the 1995 total to 98 million kg, while mail traffic handled declined 31.4 percent to 294,728 kg.
The city's Linate airport handled 66 million kg of cargo last year, down 3.3 percent on the 1995 total, while mail volume rose 12.7 percent to 12 million kg.
But passenger traffic at both airports increased last year.
At Malpensa, passengers totalled 16.37 million, up 11.2 percent on 1995, and at Linate the total was 12.6 million, up 16 percent.
